description: In Ina, IL, Oak Branch Farm raises Strawberries, Blueberries, and Blackberries on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
